'''Izzeebowe Jeef''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hermit living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Considered a soothsayer, he knew the deserts well, and would often direct search parties or predict sandstorms. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Sharack Breev]] brought the [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] to Izzeebowe Jeef in order to learn about the [[Demon's Blood]] ritual. Jeef was old and distracted easily but was able to describe the ritual for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to undertake.
